turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no budget-total metric, so I can't give the share of the September 2026 ad budget that was used; the closest metrics say 4,130 EUR of budget was still left at the end of September 2026 (Remaining budget) and 6,270 EUR of ad spend ran in September 2026 (Ad spend). Freshness: Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
